operations.body:
mutation RecordProgress($input: RecordProgressInput!) {
  recordProgress(input: $input) {
    code
    correlationId
    retryAfterMs
    progress {
      id
      profileId
      titleId
      sequence
      version
      positionMs
      durationMs
      status
      occurredAt
      updatedAt
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
